docs.title: API Craft Ecosystem
docs.text:
Welcome to the official documentation for the API Craft Ecosystem — a modular, developer-friendly toolkit designed to accelerate API development for Node.js/Express applications.

Whether you're building a simple REST API or a complex backend service, API Craft provides CLI tooling, plug-and-play routing, powerful CRUD scaffolding, and developer ergonomics that reduce boilerplate and let you focus on your business logic.

  • NPM Packages: Modular and reusable components.
  • JavaScript/TypeScript: Full support with typings.
  • CLI Generator: Scaffold production-ready APIs fast.
  • CRUD Ready: Built-in intelligent CRUD routing.
  • :fontawesome-solid-cogs: Pluggable: Middleware and plugin support.
  • Swagger & OpenAPI: First-class integration support.
  • DevTools: Better DX with logging, debugging, and more.
  • GitHub Stars: Join our growing community.

docs.title: NPM Packages
docs.text:
API Craft includes two primary packages:

  • @tselven/api-craft – A fast, pluggable Express-based API generator.
  • @api-craft/crud-router – A smart CRUD routing layer that auto-generates RESTful routes for your models.

Both packages are maintained together under the api-craft ecosystem.

docs.title: OpenAPI & Swagger Integration
docs.text:
API Craft supports automatic generation of OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation.

  • Generate Swagger docs from your routes
  • Serve interactive Swagger UI with your API
  • Customize API metadata and schemas
  • Export OpenAPI JSON/YAML for external tools

Use these features to document and share your API seamlessly.

CC++ 
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void) {
  printf("Hello world!\n");
  return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

int main(void) {
  std::cout << "Hello world!" << std::endl;
  return 0;
}
